So this is not a generic 'response is stale' issue — it is a partial one: some fields in the 200 body are the pre-write image or a miscomputed transient value, while others are accurate. A caller trusting the write's own 2xx body (rather than re-reading, per this batch's standing rule) would wrongly conclude the run kept its assignee and gained a fresh updated_at, when in storage the assignee was wiped and the timestamp never moved. Severity: high — this is a correctness gap in the write endpoint's own response, distinct from and worse than an over-declared schema field, and it is exactly the kind of silent-data-loss-disguised-as-success this suite exists to catch. Not yet known whether this is endpoint-specific to replace_test_run or shared with update_test_run — recommend the sibling probe check its own write-response fields (especially assignee/updated_at/overall_progress) against a fresh re-read rather than trusting its 200 body. || POST-STATE FOR THE update_test_run SIBLING: TR-9062 now has name (unchanged) '__mcp-probe-run-2026-09-18T06-35-00Z', description '
